A '''Sith burial shroud''' was a piece of cloth that [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Mummy/Legends|mummies]] were dressed in for [[Burial/Legends|burial]].

==Description==
Sith shrouds were often inked with incantations written in [[Kittât|Sith hieroglyphics]]. Robes known as "Wraps of Frost" acted as such shrouds, and they would steep in the corpse's dark energy and draw power from it over the centuries.<ref name="BOS" />

In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], a scrap of Sith shroud was recovered by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] along with [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] ''[[Book of Sith]]''.<ref name="BOS" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A facsimile scrap of Sith burial shroud was one of the five removable artifacts featured in the ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' deluxe edition.
